scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:contract && pnpm test:verify
scripts.docker:prune: docker buildx prune -f && docker image prune -f
scripts.helm: helm repo add traefik https://traefik.github.io/charts --force-update && helm repo update && helm upgrade --install traefik traefik/traefik --create-namespace --namespace traefik -f charts/traefik-values.yaml --wait && helm upgrade --install traefik-shared charts/traefik-shared --create-namespace --namespace platform-local
scripts.helm:down: helm uninstall traefik-shared --namespace platform-local || true; helm uninstall traefik --namespace traefik || true
scripts.skaffold: pnpm k8s:secrets && pnpm docker:base && scripts/with-buildkit.sh skaffold dev --cache-artifacts=true --cleanup=true
scripts.skaffold:reset: pnpm k8s:secrets && pnpm docker:base && scripts/with-buildkit.sh skaffold dev --cache-artifacts=false --cleanup=true
